HA="MVGALCGCWFRLGGARPLIPLGPTVVQTSMSRSQVALLGLSLLLMLLLYVGLPGPPEQTSCLWGDPNVTVLAGLTPGNSPIFYREVLPLNQAHRVEVVLLHGKAFNSHTWEQLGTLQLLSQRGYRAVALDLPGFGNSAPSKEASTEAGRAALLERALRDLEVQNAVLVSPSLSGHYALPFLMRGHHQLHGFVPIAPTSTQNYTQEQFWAVKTPTLILYGELDHILARESLRQLRHLPNHSVVKLRNAGHACYLHKPQDFHLVLLAFLDHLP"

KD=dict(A=1.8,R=-4.5,N=-3.5,D=-3.5,C=2.5,Q=-3.5,E=-3.5,G=-0.4,H=-3.2,I=4.5,L=3.8,K=-3.9,
        M=1.9,F=2.8,P=-1.6,S=-0.8,T=-0.7,W=-0.9,Y=-1.3,V=4.2)
def kd(seq,w=19):
    v=np.array([KD[c] for c in seq]); k=np.ones(w)/w
    return np.convolve(v,k,mode='same')
fig,axes=plt.subplots(3,1,figsize=(11,7),sharex=False)
maxseg={}
for ax,(name,s,col) in zip(axes,[("C. elegans ABHD-14 (Q9N366)",CE,"#2f6fb5"),
                                 ("Human ABHD14A (Q9BUJ0)",HA,"#c0504d"),
                                 ("Human ABHD14B (Q96IU4)",HB,"#4f9153")]):
    y=kd(s,19); x=np.arange(1,len(s)+1)
    ax.plot(x,y,color=col,lw=1.4); ax.axhline(1.6,ls="--",c="grey",lw=0.9)
    ax.fill_between(x,1.6,y,where=y>1.6,color=col,alpha=0.35)
    ax.set_ylabel("KD hydropathy\n(window 19)",fontsize=8)
    ax.set_title(name,fontsize=10,loc="left")
    ax.set_ylim(-3.2,3.6); ax.set_xlim(1,len(s))
    over=x[y>1.6]
    segs=[]
    if len(over):
        st=over[0];pr=over[0]
        for p in over[1:]:
            if p>pr+1: segs.append((st,pr)); st=p
            pr=p
        segs.append((st,pr))
    segs=[sg for sg in segs if sg[1]-sg[0]>=12]
    maxseg[name]=segs
    for a,b in segs:
        ax.annotate(f"TM-like {a}-{b}",xy=((a+b)/2,3.0),ha="center",fontsize=8,color=col)
axes[-1].set_xlabel("residue")
fig.suptitle("Kyte-Doolittle hydropathy: only human ABHD14A carries a predicted N-terminal membrane anchor",fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
for k,v in maxseg.items(): print(k,"TM-like segments (KD>1.6, >=13 res):",v)
